grammar.title: 举例印证猫摔不死的现象
lines: 5 Recently the New York Animal Medical Centre made a study of 132 cats over a period of five months . make a study of ... = study ... 研究 All these cats had one experience in common : they had fallen off high buildings , yet only eight of them died from shock or injuries. have sth. in common 有相同的经历 share sth. 有共同的... Of course, New York is the ideal place for such an interesting study , because there is no shortage of tall buildings. There are plenty of high-rise windowsills to fall from! One cat, Sabrina, fell 32 storeys, yet only suffered from a broken tooth. suffer (from) sth . 经历痛苦 造句：One taxi driver, Mike, was involved in a serious car accident , yet only suffered from two broken ribs .一个叫Mike的出租司机出了一次严重的车祸，然而只断了两根肋骨。 * It seems that the further cats fall , the less they are likely to injure themselves. 越...就... the further cats fall , the less they are likely.. 猫掉得越跳受到伤害的可能性就越小（按顺序翻译） In a long drop , they reach speeds of 60 miles an hour and more. They stretch out their legs like flying squirrels . stretch out 伸展 本文篇章分析 每日习语 Timely snow foretells a bumper harvest. 瑞雪兆丰年
make a study of human nature 人性的研究
make a study of human nature carefully
.., advertisers have made a close study of human nature .
...because people's descriptions of the puma had a lot in common .
These two species have certain features in common . 有某些共同的特征
We share an interest in history. 有共同的兴趣
These two species share certain features. 共同的特征
All these cats shared one experience: ... 共同的经历
fall off sth. 从...掉落 they had fallen off high buildings...
fall from sth. 从...掉下来 There are plenty of high-rise windowsills to fall from !
fall sth. 从...掉下 One cat fell 32 storeys...
die from ... 死于(死因)更强调外因... die of.. 更强调内因

die from shock or injuries / a wound / an accident 外部原因 die of a disease / hunger / grief 内部原因 ... doctors have been trying to find out whether the woman died of a rare disease . ... if we escape wars, accidents and disease we shall eventually ' die of old age', and that... NCE4-37
there is a shortage of ... 缺乏... There is a shortage of food in the refugee camps . 接不可数 There is a shortage of nurses and doctors in this area. 接可数名词
there is no shortage of ... 绝不缺乏 because there is no shortage of tall buildings. because there are plenty of tall buildings.
fall from high-rise windowsills 从高楼的窗台上摔下来
He suffered terribly the last few days. 他过去的几天痛苦不堪。
He was eventually diagnosed as suffering from terminal cancer. 他最后被诊断为癌症晚期。
far farther / further the farthest / furthest
原级 比较组 最高级
farther 物理远 、 further 抽象远 further development / investigation 更深入(长远)的发展 / 调查
The harder they worked the hungrier they became.
the + 比较级 主 + 谓 the + 比较级 主 + 谓
条件状语从句 条件状语主句
They became (the) hungrier the harder they worked . 倒过来翻译（越努力就越饿）
they are likely to injure themselves (the) less, the further cats fall . 先翻译从句

A telescope would have to be as far away as the planet Jupiter to look for life in outer space, because the dust becomes thinner the further we travel towards the outer edges of our own solar system . NCE3-55
The younger the child is , the more is the child's need of sleep. 主句太长可以倒装
The younger the child , the more the child's need of sleep. be 动词可以省略
The further off this solid obstruction , the longer time will elapse for the return of the echo. NCE4-7
The further off this solid obstruction is , the longer time will elapse.for the return of the echo. 不省略
speed n.速度 不可数名词时，与at,with搭配均可 at / with great speed
可数名词时，只能与at搭配 at a speed of 60 mph
The raid was all over in three minutes, for the men scrambled back into the car and it moved off at a fantastic speed .
The winning car reached a speed of forty miles an hour .
Racing drivers have reached speeds over 600 miles an hour .
Though the new rudder was fitted at tremendous speed , it was impossible for the Cutty Sark to win .
It now came straight towards them at tremendous speed .
you can enjoy the extraordinary sight of unbroken cloud plains that stretch out for miles before you, ... NCE3-44
You can stretch your legs on the spacious decks, ...... stretch one's legs (习语) 坐太久出去走走
“现象一解释〞型说明类文章。题目新奇，引其读者的兴趣。
第一段：引文（猫很迷人，略做陈述）→ 引出主题（最迷人之处在于有九条命一跌落时不死）
第二段：介绍一项研究并举例 → 借用医生的话展开解释原理（语言生动风趣）→ 未尾点 (flying squirrels → flying cats)
